summary: Completed comprehensive testing of VenteFlash Auto vehicle buyback website. All backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate). All frontend flows working correctly including main estimation flow, non-drivable vehicle flow, range pricing logic, UTM preservation, and security verification. No issues found.
passed_tests: Backend API root endpoint responds correctly
GET /api/settings returns configuration status (autobiz_configured: false)
GET /api/ranges returns 6 seeded default ranges with correct discount percentages
POST /api/autobiz/identify works with test plates AA123BB, CC456DD, GG012HH (MOCKED)
POST /api/autobiz/quote returns pricing with base_price, discount_percent, final_price based on ranges (MOCKED)
POST /api/leads/save stores complete lead data in car_leads collection
GET /api/leads returns saved leads with correct structure
GET /api/centers returns 5 centers as expected
GET /api/appointments/slots returns time slots
POST /api/tracking events working correctly
Homepage plate input redirects to /car-search?car_info=PLATE
/car-search page auto-identifies vehicle on load and shows vehicle card
Vehicle card displays make/model/year correctly for identified vehicles
Mileage input and condition selection working properly
Estimation flow: 'Obtenir mon estimation' shows pricing + contact form
Contact form submission navigates to /result-page with lead data
/result-page shows 'Merci' message, estimation price, next steps, contact info
Non-drivable flow: Select 'Non' shows warning and redirects to /car-estimation-page-2
/car-estimation-page-2 shows non-drivable warning and defects form
Non-drivable form submission saves lead and navigates to result page
Range pricing logic: base_price in different ranges applies correct discount percentages
UTM parameter preservation across navigation flows
Security verification: No Autobiz credentials exposed in frontend responses
All API endpoints use correct '/api' prefix for Kubernetes ingress routing
